SELECT DISTINCT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, r.data_scope AS dataScope FROM sky_role r JOIN sky_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sky_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sky_permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.permission_name = #{permissionName}

SELECT DISTINCT rd.department_id FROM sky_role_department rd JOIN sky_role r ON r.role_id = rd.role_id JOIN sky_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sky_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id JOIN sky_permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.permission_name = #{permissionName} AND r.data_scope = 'CUSTOM'
